title: Security Audit
description: Run a security assessment on a web application and generate a SARIF report.
prompt: Run a security audit on the web application at http://127.0.0.1:3000. Check for exposed files, missing security headers, TLS configuration, and common web vulnerabilities. Use the pentest_check and security_assess tools. Generate a SARIF report with all findings, severity ratings, and remediation recommendations.
